domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains to look up. URLs and email addresses are accepted and reduced to the registrable domain (www.bbc.co.uk becomes bbc.co.uk). Duplicates are skipped.

domainsText.title: Domains as text
domainsText.description: Optional. Paste a column of domains separated by new lines, spaces or commas.

includeDns.title: Include DNS records
includeDns.description: Also resolve A, AAAA, MX, NS and SPF (TXT) records for each domain and add them under dns.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Domains processed in parallel, 1-20. At most 2 requests per RDAP server run at the same time regardless of this value.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on an RDAP request or DNS lookup after this many seconds.

includeFailed.title: Keep failed lookups in the dataset
includeFailed.description: Domains with no RDAP answer (network error, timeout, rate limit) are free. Turn on to still list them with an error message.

bootstrapUrl.title: RDAP bootstrap URL
bootstrapUrl.description: Advanced. IANA bootstrap file that maps each TLD to its RDAP server. Leave empty for https://data.iana.org/rdap/dns.json.
